positive_source: ACCIDENT v9 author bbox at first visible impact, vehicle-vehicle types only; exact frame/PTS/dimensions verified
positive_exclusions: Preserve nine geometry/scope exclusions from 2026-10-26 source review; remaining author boxes are not all manually reviewed
negative_train_source: One early preimpact frame per training clip, at least 1 s file PTS before impact and before half impact frame; derived weak label, never author-negative GT
negative_validation_test_source: Previously reviewed 30 ACCIDENT preimpact frames from b0_basic_pilot_v1, same source groups
split: Custom deterministic source-group split, old pilot group assignments frozen; newly added author-IID train groups remain train where possible; not author IID or geo-aware benchmark
split_caveat: One previously frozen pilot test group is author-IID train; individual CADP/TAD overlap IDs are not published in the checked metadata, so this custom split cannot claim the paper overlap protocol
label_scope: single-image accident-region bbox only; no dense per-frame boxes, no event or long-video GT
implementation_note: Paper uses impact localization and point metric; YOLO bbox fine-tuning is this project's adapted B0 experiment, not reproduction
